contribution_reassessment.algorithmic_detail: Discrete L0–L3 intervention levels with thresholded escalate/de-escalate driven by attack success and legitimate-task utility/cost feedback, plus an explicit scalar reward combining security, utility, and defense cost. Escalate/de-escalate levels themselves are not unique (SafeHarness). Reward+legitimate-task de-escalation+fixed-level comparison as a package is distinctive but not a large algorithmic leap.
contribution_reassessment.evaluation_detail: Controlled 75/25 mixed protocol with multi-seed, temporal, family, novel/evolving, SUC/Pareto, and claim-bounded evidence packaging is the strongest evidence-supported differentiator relative to the verified critical set.
contribution_reassessment.engineering_detail: Integration of detector/risk/policy/feedback/evaluation into a reproducible MVP pipeline is an engineering contribution, not by itself scientific novelty.

safe_contributions: A controlled mixed attack/legitimate evaluation protocol comparing adaptive vs fixed discrete intervention levels under unified ASR/utility/defense-cost/reward metrics.
An explicit legitimate-task-triggered de-escalation rule coupled to defense-cost thresholds in that protocol (distinct from SafeHarness safe-window privilege recovery).
Evidence-bounded reporting that historical signal is implemented but empirically non-contributory under the AG ablation (C6 NOT SUPPORTED).
